rendered: In the BatPaC scenario, an electric vehicle with a range of 260 miles[1] and a battery pack energy of ≈76.47 kWh[2] needs a total of ≈2500 tons[3] of cobalt if NMC 111[4] is the cathode. NMC 811[5] and NCA would still need ≈700 tons[6] of cobalt. So NMC 111[7] needs about 3.6[8] times more cobalt than NMC 811[9] or NCA. The scenario assumes the pack energy and vehicle range shown above.
